unresolved_added: Equations 1 and 2 divide by x_max+x_min, so they generally do not map observed extrema to 0 and 1 despite being described as standardization and membership.
Equation 3 excludes x=x_max, has no explicit out-of-range branch, and its denominators do not center the optimum at one under general positive endpoints.
Equation 4 visibly prints an extra 's(i)=' inside the first b_ij branch, and the following b_m definition ends with a dangling 'min'.
Equation 7 visibly minimizes |y_ij-b_ji| rather than |y_ij-b_ij|, so the intended proximity target must be confirmed before implementation.
The printed 13-by-13 matrix contains entries such as 27.42 and visually suspicious reciprocal inconsistencies even though CIC 0.032 is reported.
The Experience consistency result is printed only as 'min CIC(n)=<0.1' without a numeric CIC value.
The paper calls five-of-five name overlap 100 percent accuracy even when the ranking order differs.
Pat Summitt's 0.883, baseball scores, basketball scores, and football scores come from different metric systems and scales, so the cross-sport maximum is not established as comparable.
The time-horizon conclusion generalizes from four selected coach plots without a documented randomization frame, statistical trend model, or uncertainty.
The reasonable-hypothesis test infers data reliability and assumption validity from outputs produced by those same data and assumptions.
The sensitivity equations use r(i,j) for normalized values and r_j for the perturbation magnitude without a clean symbol contract; the sweep can also leave feasible normalized ranges.
No frozen source tables, retrieval snapshots, spreadsheets, LINGO program, MATLAB code, environment lock, or end-to-end reproduction log is supplied.

validation_results.details: All 35/35 physical pages have extracted text and rendered pixels. Visual review used four byte-bounded contact-sheet JPEGs for complete page coverage and four focused formula crops; no original full-page PNG entered model transport.
144 language units cover all 18 declared protocol chapters with quantitative layouts, reusable slots, variants, and boundaries.
144/144 language units passed against the complete 35-page source text with no failed original-instantiation checks.
15 model and algorithm interfaces retain 17 source-anchored equations plus conditions, handoffs, validation links, and limitations.
Eighteen five-part chapter contracts, the seven-paragraph Abstract chain, the one-paragraph Introduction chain, six main arguments, 31 visual dispositions, and 12 final warning records passed.
The paper card, 415 observations, 23 cumulative B rules, extraction, language/model records, and complete visual review cross-validate.
Twelve nominated B rules received source-matched Queue 105 evidence without lifecycle changes; staged output is frozen at 0e3b6e338dc79f97a42af4ee5d9f6f24be4f5468a19a64129f897301804731fb.
The live plan retains language-first G0-G8 ordering and prospective/live transaction ordering.
All 119 regression tests pass against the Queue 105 staged bytes and current formal baseline.
Queue 105 used one JPEG per image tool call, every proxy was below 450,000 bytes, the context segment stopped at eight proxies, and no full session JSONL or original-page PNG was transported.
